name: LOW-VIX armed trend continuation — Greed-confirmed risk-on momentum
rationale: Thesis: calm macro vol (VIX lt vix_ceiling) plus crypto sentiment leaning risk-on (Fear&Greed gt greed_floor, BOUNDED) is the cleanest trend-continuation regime — both the equity-vol market and the crypto crowd are constructive, so up-momentum (ret_Nd gt mom_floor) persists. Two independent regime gauges agreeing reduces whipsaw. Exit when sentiment rolls back below fear_exit OR momentum fails OR risk/time stops. Disconfirmer 1 (is the sentiment gate load-bearing?): the identical low-VIX + momentum long with NO Fear&Greed gate is in the cohort — if it matches the deflated Sharpe, the sentiment confirmation adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2 (is it just buying greed-tops?): if the edge flips negative when greed is HIGH, this is late-cycle FOMO, not continuation, and FAILs. Disconfirmer 3 (holdout): purged+embargoed recent slice must hold.
catalyst: VIX calm AND Fear&Greed risk-on AND positive momentum
